brands.evidence: Yes, Monzo does freeze accounts. Most banks do. Monzo says it does this to keep your money safe

client_claims.text: Monzo does freeze accounts, usually triggered by fraud or security flags.
Monzo's terms say it reserves the right to close an account at any time, particularly if it believes fraud is taking place.
In 2019 Monzo told the BBC that a frozen account is typically reactivated in ten minutes if activity isn't suspicious.
You can email help@monzo.com if you can't get into the app.
A phone number, 0800 802 1281, was listed in a 2020 community post.
For a PIN block, tap the Card button, choose Reveal PIN, and have your card and ID ready to take a video.
Monzo's help page says it can't give a specific timeline for a review and will unfreeze the account once checks are complete.
Monzo will contact you in the app if it needs further information.
If Monzo hasn't resolved a complaint within 8 weeks you can usually take it to the Financial Ombudsman Service.
client_claims.note: General UK rules, not a Monzo fact.
